SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
Special Br. 1 Station.
File No. 7522
Date April 18th 1932）

Subject (in full) reported arrest of Wong Ts-liang 王子良 and Koo Chia Zai 顧家齋

Made by Supt Tan Shao Liang Forwarded by Thos Robertson Capt.

It is reported that the Chinese Authorities at Chinkiang
arrested on April 15 one Wong Ts-liang and one Koo Chia Zai
both of whom were formerly intelligence officers at the
Woosung forts and sent them to Nanking on a charge of being Japanese
spies. It is reported that efforts to secure the release
of these prisoners are now being made by Hwang Cheng-yung
and Doo Yueh-sung.

Koo Chia Zai was formerly a detective constable in the
Municipal Police. He left this force some four years ago and became
a member of the Opium Smuggling Gang in French Town where he acquired considerable
wealth.

（批：sec
D.J.452.）

A bomb explosion occurred recently at Wong Ts-liang's house
at No.3 Rue Amiral Bayle, French Concession.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

Officer i/c S.B.

Commissioner of Police,
Sir,

报告

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
特别分部第一站。
档案编号 7522
日期 1932年4月18日）

事由（全称）：关于逮捕王子良（Wong Ts-liang）和顧家齋（Koo Chia Zai）的报告

由谭绍良警司呈报，经罗伯逊（Thos Robertson）上尉转呈。

据报，镇江中国当局于4月15日逮捕了王子良一人及顧家齋一人，二人此前均曾任吴淞炮台的情报军官，现以日本间谍罪名被押送南京。据报，黄成镛（Hwang Cheng-yung）和杜月笙（Doo Yueh-sung）目前正在设法营救上述囚犯。

顧家齋此前系本警务处的一名侦探巡捕。他于约四年前离开本警队，成为法租界鸦片走私帮伙的成员，并在此期间积累了大量财富。

（批注：sec
D.J.452。）

近期，位于法租界贝勒路（Rue Amiral Bayle）3号的王子良寓所发生了一起炸弹爆炸事件。

谭绍良
警司。

特别分部主管警官。
